section.title: Introduction
section.t: This document describes CSOAI's measurement and evidence infrastructure as it relates to the IETF community. CSOAI Ltd (UK Companies House 16939677) maintains signed measurement cards for AI governance evidence at councilof.ai.

section.title: Evidence Model
section.t: Each measurement card contains a subject identifier, axis, accuracy with Wilson 95 percent confidence interval, sample size, run identifier, harness and grader version, and cryptographic signature (Ed25519 with DID-bound keys).

section.title: Verification
section.t: Cards are verified via Ed25519 signature, Merkle root inclusion, and Rekor transparency-log witness. The root is published at https://councilof.ai/root.json with per-card SHA-256 leaves and inclusion proofs available via /api/proof.

section.title: Security Considerations
section.t: Private signing keys are never placed in source code, artifacts, logs, or browser storage. The signing ceremony uses GitHub OIDC with off-device key custody per did:web:csoai.org. Failures fail closed and preserve UNCHECKABLE rather than substituting defaults.
